title: Scenic Helicopter Flight-60 Minutes-Anchorage Area
includes: 1 Hour of Stunning Heli Flight over Knik Glacier and River Valley
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Accurately reporting weight is essential for proper weight and balance of the helicopter. Large discrepancies in reported weights may result in additional fees.
Solo Travelers: Please note that we may reach out to reschedule your time if a 2 person minimum is not met.
CHECK IN TIME is 30 minutes prior to departure time. If you arrive late your excursion may be shortened, cancelled or rescheduled with no refund given.
Weight limit is 300lbs per seat. R44 max weight is 650lbs, R66 max weight is 900lbs
Groups of 4+ may be split into multiple helicopters

WEIGHT SURCHARGES: Groups of 2 over 500lbs, groups of 3 over 650lbs and groups of 4 over 900lbs will be charged a weight surcharge. You can call 907-351-6736 to pay the additional weight surcharge within 48 hours of making the reservation. If weight surcharge not paid, we cannot guarantee extra aircraft will be available and flight may be rescheduled or canceled without a refund.
Infants are defined as 0-23 months. Children at or over 24 months will need to be in a paid seat. This is a FAA regulation and not a suggestion
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See the best of Alaska's backcountry from the air as your helicopter pilot takes you on an epic flying adventure past mountains and over dramatic glacial features & braided rivers.

Experience unobstructed, bird’s eye views of stunning mountain peaks, local wildlife, towering waterfalls, dramatic glacial terrain, iceberg filled lakes and the beauty that is unique to Alaska.

Choose your flight path based on your bucket list items to see and let your pilot show you what you would be missing if you stayed on the ground. Look for wildlife and ask your pilot where their favorite secret spot is.

After an hour flying in the chopper and you will have a new favorite mode of transport!
